edits.previous: `Fin` is also checked inside `Array`, `List` and `Option` at parameters and results, including nested combinations such as `Array (Option (Fin 10))` and aliases such as `abbrev Digits := Array (Fin 10)`. The bundled adapter checks every present element before Lean is called. An empty array or `none` is valid even for `Fin 0`. Generated documentation writes element bounds as `arg0[*] < 10` and present option values as `arg0? < 10`. CPAN's XS checks use typed accessors and name the failing element, for example `arg0[2]? is not below its Fin 10 bound`. [Four-ABI CPAN acceptance](../evidence/perl-refinements-20261009.md) covers ordinary-source and reviewed container packages on Perl 5.36.3 and 5.38.2, threaded and unthreaded. Each complete consumer passes before and after the installed package tree moves, with author sources removed and no compiler or network access. This container evidence does not cover the separate top-level scalar relocation gate.
